generation.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original vertical 2:3 editorial photograph for a Pinterest prompt card. A fictional stylish 55-year-old man with short salt-and-pepper curls and subtle stubble, navy wool blazer and terracotta scarf, frontal waist-up portrait placed slightly left of center on an evening railway platform. His face is tack sharp with authentic skin texture, calm direct gaze, warm side light. Anonymous commuters and train windows form horizontal motion streaks in the background, cool teal evening ambience with restrained amber lights. Head near upper quarter, torso ends around lower two thirds. Lower quarter quiet dark navy negative space for later typography. Premium cinematic 50mm photo, fine film grain, realistic anatomy. No text, no logos, no watermark. Do not reproduce any reference image or recognizable person.
